product.name: Orbit+
product.tagline: Find the work that pulls you in.

projects.title: Open-source AI Research Assistant
projects.summary: Build an open-source AI agent that helps researchers discover, read, and understand scientific papers with citations, summaries, and a focus on accurate reasoning.
projects.description: A research companion for finding relevant papers, tracing citations, and turning dense technical writing into an auditable reading path.

projects.title: Campus Pantry
projects.summary: A quiet logistics layer for students who need food support without another form maze.
projects.description: Campus Pantry maps existing campus resources into one dignified, low-bandwidth experience. The first version helps students find what is available tonight, not next semester.

projects.title: Quiet Hours
projects.summary: A small instrument that helps a room remember when it is time to soften.
projects.description: Quiet Hours turns a shared room into a kinder space through subtle light, sound, and presence cues. No productivity theatre. Just a better threshold between focus and rest.

projects.title: Atlas of Small Wins
projects.summary: A visual memory for the tiny breakthroughs that disappear before we name them.
projects.description: Atlas turns notes, screenshots, and shipped moments into a personal map of progress. It is part journal, part retrieval system, and deliberately not a leaderboard.

projects.title: Tidepool
projects.summary: Make neighborhood climate action feel as immediate as checking the weather.
projects.description: Tidepool turns local heat, flood, and air-quality signals into small collective actions. It is designed for communities that do not need another doom dashboard.

projects.title: Ritual / 00
projects.summary: A beautiful five-minute reset for people who make things on screens.
projects.description: Ritual / 00 is a tiny local-first app for opening and closing a creative session. It pairs one question, one visual timer, and one trace of what changed.

projects.title: Murmur
projects.summary: A slower way to hear what a neighborhood already knows.
projects.description: Murmur is an audio-first layer for local stories. Walk a block, leave a minute, and hear the place become more than a pin on a map.

activity.title: Atlas of Small Wins is waiting
